works.title: Barb McGowan (Fury Voice for MSI)
works.description: A new persona/voice for Main Street Independent embodying the Fury archetype—a hypocrisy-hunter from Friendship, Wisconsin who writes passionate advocacy journalism on economic justice. Combines short analytical essays with cartoon commentary featuring a sardonic cat, using direct language and evidence-based policy analysis. Character fully specified with visual identity, sourcing standards, and multiple published articles.
works.quote: The function you're designing — hunt the ones who violate their own professed code, punish the arrogant who've grown too big — *is* the Fury.

works.title: After the Fire
works.description: A poem or song with a specific musical and emotional structure centered on intimacy, closure, and peaceful connection. Built on a refrain pattern with 'Sleep now my mountain' repeated three times in shifting positions within three distinct stanzas, creating a melodic progression from disorientation to complete peace. Soft rhythmic pacing, gentle imagery, and emphasis on wordless connection.
works.quote: Sleep now my mountain. That phrase should be repeated three times. The first time she does it, she sings that three times, then adds something, then pauses.
